feedback_by_option.fil: Maaaring mailipat ng kamay ang secretions sa gamit.
feedback_by_option.en: Hands may transfer secretions to objects.

feedback_by_option.fil: Natatakpan ang ilong at bibig nang hindi ginagamit ang palad.
feedback_by_option.en: This covers nose and mouth without using hands.

feedback_by_option.fil: Dapat gayahin lamang ang kilos at hindi ilantad ang kapareha.
feedback_by_option.en: Mime the action without exposing the partner.

feedback_by_option.fil: Maaaring may kontaminasyon pa sa kamay.
Hindi dapat ibahagi o gamitin muli ang ginamit na tissue.
feedback_by_option.en: Used tissues should not be shared or reused.

feedback_by_option.fil: Bahagi ng kumpletong sequence ang hand hygiene.
feedback_by_option.en: Hand hygiene is part of the complete sequence.
